new.statement: Lower like ratios go with higher Top Trending positions among young games of similar age (divisive hook games climb while polished niche games stay lower)
Raise-a-family games where adopted children keep ageing while the player is offline (Raise Your Family!, Raise The Biggest Family) climb Up-and-Coming by giving players a reason to return daily
new.action: Let raised characters grow while offline
new.rationale: Profiled 2026-11-14: Raise The Biggest Family rose 34 on Up-and-Coming at 32 days and Raise Your Family! was queued as a new game; both advertise offline growth and sell time skips. Confirm if more offline-growth raise games reach the top half of Up-and-Coming within their first month; refute if they fade within a week like other single-hook waves.

new.statement: Driving roleplays set in a recreated real city with a local identity (Riyadh in Kingdom World, Roanoke VA, Young Street Ontario, Indonesian Drag Drive) earn well for their audience and last, because the real setting and car culture give a ready-made reason to roleplay
new.action: Recreate a real city for driving roleplay
new.rationale: Profiled 2026-11-14: Kingdom World (535 days) entered Top Earning today, and four of the 60 profiled games are real-city driving roleplays with long lives. Confirm if these games keep a top-half Top Earning efficiency and stay on charts for months; refute if they sit in the bottom half of efficiency like other open-world sims.

qualitative_updates.note: Mukbang Students entered Up-and-Coming and Be a Teacher! entered Top Trending today, joining Class Clowns: three classroom 1-vs-all games (sneak snacks or prank while the teacher watches) charted within two days.

Showcases keep arriving (Car Destruction Engine, Anime Ragdoll Engine, Create A Disaster profiled today; Ragdoll Destruction Playground entered Top Trending), but they don't hold: Tornado Ragdoll Sandbox fell 24 on Up-and-Coming and WRECKED fell 21 on Top Trending. Single-effect showcases get on the charts but don't stay.

Mixed today: 13-day-old Tornado Ragdoll Sandbox fell while 13-day-old Anime Ragdoll Engine entered, so turnover isn't simply by age; the wave's physics-sandbox Up-and-Coming signal dropped from 64% to 49%.
Cook Pizzas [Anomaly] rose 19 on Top Trending at 22 days despite a 70% like ratio, another cute-job-plus-anomaly game holding up.
